sections.title: Description
sections.text: Siodil D-Pigment Cleanser is formulated with active ingredients like Lactic Acid, Kojic Acid, and Sodium Cocoyl Glycinate that help cleanse and treat hyperpigmentation (sunspots, melasma, and age spots) while improving skin tone and texture.

sections.title: Features & Details
sections.text: Lactic Acid is an organic acid that is part of the Alpha-Hydroxy Acid (AHA) family. The main function of this ingredient is to treat moderate to severe hyperpigmentation and show successful results in treating melasma, which works by blocking tyrosinase, therefore reducing melanin production Kojic Acid treats melasma by acting as a tyrosinase inhibitor. Tyrosinase is a special enzyme located in melanocytes, the cells that produce melanin, a substance that gives color to your eyes, skin, and hair. Kojic acid prevents the formation of tyrosine, an amino acid converted by tyrosinase. This reduced production of tyrosine results in less melanin production, leading to an improved complexion and fewer dark patches caused by melasma. Sodium Cocoyl Glycinate is an amino acid-derived cleansing agent considered to be a mild, non-drying cleanser and surfactant composed of glycine and a fatty acid. It is primarily used as a cleanser that deeply cleanses the skin, leaving it smooth and soft. This ingredient provides a rich lather that feels good upon application and is considered safe and non-irritating to the skin

sections.title: Description
sections.text: Siodil Anti-Scar Gel is an advanced scar restorative infused with Panthenol, Hexapeptide-9, Dimethicone, and Allantoin, offering a clinical solution to scar management. These active ingredients, working synergistically, stimulate collagen production, enhance skin hydration without greasiness, alleviate scar-related itching, exfoliate dead skin cells, and gently remove the skin’s outer layer.

sections.title: Features & Details
sections.text: Dimethicone enhances blood circulation, aiding in quicker scar softening and reduction. Allantoin accelerates wound healing and softens the skin. Hexapeptide-9 boosts collagen synthesis and reduces acne and chickenpox scars. Panthenol stimulates increased cell division in connective tissue cells and their precursors, effectively aiding in the treatment of scars and burns.

sections.title: Active Ingredients
sections.text: Dimethicone, Allantoin, Hexapeptide-9, and Panthenol

sections.title: Benefits

sections.title: Recommended Uses For Product
sections.text: Siodil Anti-Scar Gel effectively reduces the appearance of scar marks and improves skin texture.

sections.title: Description
sections.text: Siodil Sebi Cleanser is a highly effective cleanser formulated with key active ingredients, including natural Shea Butter, Glycolic Acid, and Salicylic Acid. This advanced formulation is designed to exfoliate dead skin cells and effectively remove impurities and dirt from the surface of the face. Skin Concern Acne / Pimples, Clogged Pores, Dark Spots, Uneven Skin tone Ingredients based benefits Glycolic Acid is also known as Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) It is generally used for anti-aging hyperpigmentation, dryness, and acne treatment. Salicylic Acid, a well-known Beta Hydroxy Acid (BHA), effectively reduces acne by exfoliating dead skin cells, clearing pores, and is most suitable for mild acne like blackheads and whiteheads. Shea butter, rich in fatty acids and vitamins, is an excellent cleanser for dry and sensitive skin. It hydrates, softens, and contains anti-inflammatory properties that reduce swelling and redness. Acrylates creates the creamy texture and foamy lather. These effects improve the sensory experience

sections.title: Product Description
sections.text: NIOR Red Carpet Liquid Matte Lip Color redefines your lip look with unparalleled style and durability. Featuring a sophisticated matte finish, this formula delivers intense, saturated color while nourishing your lips with shea butter and oils, ensuring a confident, long-lasting appearance from dawn till dusk.

sections.title: Features & Benefits
sections.text: * Matte Perfection: Helps achieve a flawless, even matte finish, ensuring your lips look impeccably smooth and shine-free. * Intense Pigmentation: Delivers rich, saturated color with every swipe, perfect for creating both bold and subtle looks. * Non-Drying Formula: Enriched with shea butter and oils for lips that stay hydrated and feel featherlight. * Long-Wearing Comfort: Offers a comfortable formula that remains intact from dawn to dusk. * Easy Application: Equipped with a precision applicator that allows for effortless definition and contouring of your lips.

sections.title: Directions
sections.text: 1. Prep Your Lips: Exfoliate and moisturize for a smooth canvas. 2. Let It Set: Allow a few moments for the lipstick to dry and set into its matte finish.

sections.title: Description
sections.text: Siodil D-Pigment Cream, formulated with active ingredients like Niacinamide, Ethyl Ascorbic Acid and Kojic Acid helps to reduce the appearance of dark patches and spots, hyperpigmentation, and uneven skin tone, subsequently improving the overall skin tone and texture.

sections.title: Features & Details
sections.text: Kojic Acid is a natural skin-lightening agent that helps to reduce the appearance of dark spots and uneven skin tone. It works by inhibiting the production of melanin, the pigment that causes dark spots in melasma. Its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties also protect and soothe the skin from further damage. Ethyl Ascorbic Acid acts as an anti-pigmentary agent. It interacts with copper ions at the active site of the tyrosinase enzyme, thereby inhibiting the enzyme’s action. Tyrosinase is the main enzyme responsible for converting tyrosine into melanin, thus decreasing melanin formation and improving skin tone. Niacinamide has been proven to block the transfer of melanin to skin cells, which may help to lower melanin synthesis and stop the development of new dark patches brought on by melasma.Its anti-inflammatory characteristics may aid in calming and soothing the skin, which is crucial for melasma-prone skin that may be sensitive or inflamed.

sections.title: Ingredients
sections.text: Aqua, Glycerin, Light Liquid Paraffin, Niacinamide, Cetyl Alcohol, Helianthus Annus (Sunflower) Oil, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, Ceteareth-40, Cetearyl Olivate, Sorbitan Olivate, Glyceryl Isostearate, Capric/Caprylic/Succinic Triglyceride, Butyrspermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, 1,2- Hexanediol, Dimethicone, Phenoxyethanol, Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Kojic Acid, Acrylates/C 10-30 Alkyl Acrylates Crosspolymer, Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Disodium EDTA, Xanthan Gum, and Sodium Hydroxide.

sections.title: Description
sections.text: SIODIL Baby Diaper Paste is a Zinc-based emollient cream that soothes and protects the skin. It serves as a protective layer between the skin and potentially irritating substances. Apart from its application in managing diaper rashes, it has been found to be effective in addressing minor skin conditions such as eczema, scratches, itching, and skin irritation.

sections.title: Features & Details
sections.text: Zinc Oxide exhibits mild antiseptic and astringent characteristics, thereby facilitating the relief and recovery of inflamed skin. It forms a protective layer over the affected area, allowing the skin to recover by reducing inflammation and promoting the healing process. Glycerine is a humectant, which means it helps to attract and retain moisture. Glycerine, when applied to the skin, can aid in hydrating and moisturizing the afflicted area, which is beneficial for dry or irritated skin, which is commonly seen in diaper rash. Petrolatum forms a protective barrier on the skin’s surface, preventing moisture from coming into direct contact with the skin. This barrier function helps keep the baby’s skin dry and protected from urine and stool, which can cause diaper rash. Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil can help hydrate and nourish the skin, which can be beneficial for dry or irritated skin commonly associated with diaper rash. Tocopherol Acetate can contribute to strengthening the skin’s natural barrier function. This may help protect the skin from irritants, such as urine and feces, and prevent further moisture loss, providing a supportive environment for healing. Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate assists in blending water-based and oil-based ingredients in the diaper paste, ensuring that the formulation is well-mixed and uniform. This helps create a consistent texture which facilitates easy application of the paste onto the baby’s skin.

sections.title: Description
sections.text: Siodil D-Pigment SPF 60 is a unique triple-combination topical therapy for dark spots associated with moderate-to-severe facial melasma. This mineral-based sunscreen with SPF 60 is formulated with a Broad-Spectrum UV Filter, Tocopheryl Acetate, and Sodium Hyaluronate, protecting the skin against pigment (melanin) triggered by hormones or environmental factors while also shielding it from harmful UVA and UVB rays.

sections.title: Features & Details
sections.text: Broad-Spectrum UV Filter is an important adjunct therapy for preventing the exacerbation of hyperpigmentation and improving the appearance of these conditions by stabilizing and addressing pigmentary disorders in skin color. Tocopheryl Acetate, the most common form of Vitamin E, helps protect against UV-induced damage, moisturizes the skin, reduces inflammation, and enhances the efficacy of sunscreen. Additionally, Tocopherol plays a vital role in controlling hyperpigmentation by inhibiting melanin synthesis and acts as a natural nourishing agent for the skin. Sodium Hyaluronate is a powerful humectant that attracts and binds moisture to the skin. Its smaller molecular structure is synthesized for enhanced stability and increased resistance to oxidation, allowing it to penetrate deeper into the skin and provide intense hydration beyond the surface. Additionally, it exhibits unique viscoelasticity along with moisturizing and anti-inflammatory properties.

sections.title: Description
sections.text: D32 ION 360 Smart Toothbrush Head features advanced Tynex Bristles, offering a gentle yet effective clean. Engineered for comfort, it promotes healthier gums and provides a superior brushing experience.

sections.title: Features & Details
sections.text: 3x Eco-Friendly Replaceable Toothbrush Heads Tynex Soft Bristles Color Fading Reminder

sections.title: Directions
sections.text: How to Use 1. Pull the old brush head straight off the handle. 2. Push the new brush head onto the power shaft until it clicks into place. No need to rotate. 3. Rinse the brush head before first use and after each brushing session. 4. Replace the brush head every 3 months, or sooner if bristles are worn.

sections.title: Benefits
sections.text: 3× Eco-Friendly Replaceable Toothbrush Heads: Includes three durable, eco-conscious brush heads—designed to reduce waste while keeping your brushing fresh. Tynex Soft Bristles: High-quality Tynex bristles are soft, flexible, and gentle on gums while delivering an effective clean.

sections.title: Recommended Uses For Product
sections.text: Do not share brush heads and replace them every three months as recommended by dentists. Use only with D32 ION 360 Smart Toothbrush. Remove and properly dispose of the used brush head before attaching a new one.

sections.title: Description
sections.text: Explore the world of advanced oral hygiene with the D32 ION 360 Smart Toothbrush, combining smart features with superb performance. Engineered for powerful plaque removal and gentle gum care, it delivers a brighter, healthier smile with every use.

sections.title: Features & Details
sections.text: 30 Days Long-Lasting Battery Life 2 Minute Smart Clean 3 Cleaning Modes IPX 7 waterproof Color Fading Reminder Ultra Slim Design & Lightweight

sections.title: Directions
sections.text: 1. Install the brush head correctly (insert the brush head onto the power shaft; no need to rotate). 2. Apply a small amount of toothpaste to the bristles. Turn on the toothbrush after placing it in your mouth. 3. Place the brush head at a 45° angle to the gum line and gently brush your teeth back and forth. A short vibration every 30 seconds indicates it’s time to change the brushing area. The toothbrush will automatically shut off when the brushing mode ends. 4. Rinse the toothbrush head and bristles after each use and allow them to air dry.

sections.title: Benefits

IPX7 Waterproof Design: Safe to use in the shower or rinse under running water without worry. Built to withstand long-term exposure to bathroom moisture. Color Fading Reminder: Indicator bristles gradually fade in color to let you know when it’s time to replace the brush head. Ultra-Slim & Lightweight: Streamlined design makes it comfortable to hold and easy to pack—perfect for travel and daily use.

sections.title: Recommended Uses For Product
sections.text: 1. Do not share the brush heads with others. Dentists recommend replacing the brush heads every three months. 2. Please replace the brush heads with those of the same brand. 3. The toothbrush contains a battery. If you dispose of it, please remove the battery and discard it in the appropriate waste disposal bin. 4. This product is designed for adults only.

sections.title: Description
sections.text: Turn every look into a statement with Maxbeu Silky Matte Liquid Lipstick — a perfect combination of intense color and silky comfort. This lightweight liquid formula glides effortlessly onto your lips, delivering rich pigmentation in just one swipe and setting into a smooth, soft matte finish

sections.title: Features & Details
sections.text: Experience the professional edge with Max Beu Silky Matte Liquid Lipstick. Engineered with Shea Butter, Jojoba Oil, and Olive Oil, this high-pigment formula delivers a smudge-proof, velvet finish without the dryness. This non-drying matte lipstick locks in moisture to prevent cracking, offering the comfort of a premium lip treatment with the boldness of a long-wear liquid matte.

sections.title: Ingredients
sections.text: Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Silica, Microcrystalline Wax, Isononyl Isononanoate, Triethylhexanoin, Isopropyl Palmitate, Poly- methylsilsesquioxane, Neopentyl Glycol Diheptanoate, Polyethelene, Bis-Diglyceryl Polyacyladipate-2, Isopropyl Titanium Triisos- tearate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Kernel Oil, and Fragrance. MAY CONTAIN (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxide (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090), Red 6 Lake (CI 15850), Red 7 Lake (CI 15850), Red 28 Lake (CI 45410), Red 30 Lake (CI 73360), Red 40 Lake (CI 16035), and Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140).

sections.title: Active Ingredient(s)
sections.text: Shea Butter, Jojoba oil,Olive oil

sections.title: Directions
sections.text: Apply to clean, dry lips using the applicator. Glide from the center outward for smooth, even coverage. Let it set for a few seconds to achieve a flawless silky matte finish. Layer for a bolder, more dramatic look.

sections.title: Benefits
sections.text: Maxbeu Silky Matte Liquid Lipstick gives a full matte, highly pigmented finish while feeling lightweight and silky for all-day comfort.

sections.title: Recommended Uses For Product
